liveProjects.title: Lane Runner
liveProjects.description: An interactive lane‑running game built with TypeScript and React, where players dodge obstacles and switch lanes for higher scores. Deployed on Netlify for smooth and accessible gameplay.

liveProjects.title: Live Location Sharing
liveProjects.description: A JavaScript app that uses the Geolocation API to capture latitude and longitude, then sends updates via WebSockets to a server. The server broadcasts these coordinates to all connected clients, showing everyone’s live positions on a shared map.

liveProjects.title: Calculator
liveProjects.description: A simple calculator built with TypeScript and React, supporting basic arithmetic operations with a clean UI. Deployed on Netlify for easy access and smooth performance.
